title: jams engine prefab, format v4

$schema.description: Path or URI of this file's JSON Schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

v.description: The scene format version it was written at.

id.description: The prefab's id; matches the file name without .json.
id.title: Id

base.description: The prefab this one is a variant of: its children are the base's, with `overrides` applied, plus this file's own.
base.title: Base

contract.description: This game defines no prefab contract, so a prefab carries none.

params.description: Exposed parameters by name. An instance's `params` value applies as an override of each target; a variant inherits its base's and may redeclare one.
params.title: Parameters

description.description: One sentence for the inspector and agents.

targets.description: Override paths inside the prefab that the value feeds, e.g. `door.path.speed`.

default.description: Used when an instance sets none; omitted, the targets' own values stand.

map.description: Per target, the value it takes for each string value of the param, e.g. `{ "unit.behaviors.sprite.frame": { "red": "knight-red" } }`. A mapped target with no entry for the value keeps its own; targets left out take the value as it is.

additionalProperties.description: An exposed parameter: one value an instance sets that overrides every target.

assets.description: Asset ids only game code names, so they count as used: sorted, each once.
assets.title: Assets

overrides.description: A variant's changes to its base's children, keyed `<childId>.<field.path>`; `off: true` hides one.
overrides.title: Overrides

bulk.description: Id-less bulk entries by bulk key, as a scene holds them.

solid.description: Static ground shapes, absolute metres; `solid:<material>` for a material. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~solid:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape. Absolute world metres; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.
items.title: Shape

instances.description: Instances of other prefabs nested in this one, placed around its origin. Their children load with ids `<instance>/<child>` under this prefab's own instance.

entities.description: Entities with their ids, as a scene holds them; ids are renamed on paste if taken.

description: A prefab: entities, bulk entries and nested instances around a local origin, placed in scenes by instances, optionally a variant of a base prefab. Coordinates are relative to the origin, which an instance's `at` puts in the world. `entities` is required and may be empty.

ShapeTuple.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...] | ["chain", x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]. Metres, y is down; rotDeg in degrees.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: circle
oneOf.description: Circle (a Rapier ball) by centre and radius.

oneOf.title: capsule
oneOf.description: Capsule, vertical before rotation: a segment of half-length halfLen through the centre, swept by radius r.

prefixItems.description: Half the length of the inner segment.
Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Convex polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points). Points are absolute; the loader centres the body on their centroid. Concave outlines must be split or drawn as a chain.

oneOf.title: chain
oneOf.description: Open polyline as flat x, y pairs (at least 2 points), for static terrain. Allowed on solid and sensor only.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the scene: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Ops and other entities refer to the entity by it.
id.title: Id

prefab.description: The prefab placed here: the file prefabs/<prefab>.json beside the scene.
prefab.title: Prefab

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

layer.description: Scene layer, one of the game's layers; omitted means the type's default. The editor shows, hides and locks entities by layer, and the engine's own visuals draw on it; a type's shape visuals keep the draw layer their system chooses.
layer.title: Layer

group.description: The declared group (top-level `groups`) this belongs to. Its geometry is stored relative to the group's `at`, and members select and move together.
group.title: Group

off.description: When true the entity stays in the file but is not loaded, e.g. to A/B a change without deleting it.
off.title: Disabled

z.description: Added to the z of every child, an integer in [-10000, 10000]. Omitted means 0.
z.title: Z

at.description: Where the prefab's origin lands, in world metres (relative to the group's origin when in a group).
at.title: Position

rot.description: Quarter turns clockwise (y down), applied after `flip`. Omitted means 0.
rot.title: Rotation

flip.description: Mirror x in the local frame, before `rot`. Omitted means not mirrored.
flip.title: Mirror

params.description: Values of the prefab's exposed parameters, by name.
params.title: Parameters

overrides.description: Child fields that differ from the prefab, keyed `<childId>.<field.path>` (`door.path.speed`, `~solid:0.shape`). Values are in the prefab's own frame, before `at`.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the scene: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Ops and other entities refer to the entity by it.
id.title: Id

type.description: A walkable area, or a hole in one, for navigation without physics or a grid.
type.title: Type

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

layer.description: Scene layer, one of the game's layers; omitted means the type's default. The editor shows, hides and locks entities by layer, and the engine's own visuals draw on it; a type's shape visuals keep the draw layer their system chooses.
layer.title: Layer

group.description: The declared group (top-level `groups`) this belongs to. Its geometry is stored relative to the group's `at`, and members select and move together.
group.title: Group

off.description: When true the entity stays in the file but is not loaded, e.g. to A/B a change without deleting it.
off.title: Disabled

z.description: Draw order within the layer, an integer in [-10000, 10000]; higher draws on top, ties keep spawn order (on a y-sorted layer, z first, then y). Omitted means 0.
z.title: Z

shape.description: A simple polygon, concave allowed. Absolute world metres; y is down.
shape.title: Shape

mode.description: walk (default) or a hole cut out of the walk area it lies in.
mode.title: Mode

tags.description: Labels a game reads, e.g. a room name.
tags.title: Tags

asset.description: The texture, or the atlas whose frame it draws.
asset.title: Asset

frame.description: The atlas frame's name; required for an atlas.

size.description: Drawn size in world metres; omitted, the frame's pixel size over the game's px per metre, times scale.

scale.description: Used when size is omitted; default 1.

anchor.description: 0–1 in the frame; default its pivot, else the centre.

prefixItems.description: x: 0 the frame's left edge, 1 its right.
y: 0 the frame's top, 1 its bottom.

offset.description: World metres from the pose to the anchor; turns and flips with the instance.

tint.description: 0xRRGGBB multiplied into the texture; default the material's, else none.

flipX.description: Mirror left–right; an instance flip toggles it.

blend.description: How it composites over what is below; default the material's, else normal.

nineSlice.description: Insets in texture px; default the import's.

turn.description: Turn with the pose; default true.

sprite.description: Draws a texture or an atlas frame at the entity's pose.
sprite.title: sprite

blocks.description: Whether its cell is impassable to paths while it stands there; default true.

occupant.description: Stands on the grid cell under its pose, where paths and game code see it.
occupant.title: occupant

ticks.description: Ticks until it goes; give this or `ms`.

ms.description: Milliseconds until it goes, rounded to ticks at the run's rate; give this or `ticks`.

lifetime.description: Destroys or disables the entity a time after it spawns or is enabled.
lifetime.title: lifetime

shape.description: The collision shape, local to the entity's pose: centred on 0, 0 for one around it (e.g. ["box", 0, 0, 0.25, 0.25]). Not chain.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: circle
oneOf.description: Circle (a Rapier ball) by centre and radius.

oneOf.title: capsule
oneOf.description: Capsule, vertical before rotation: a segment of half-length halfLen through the centre, swept by radius r.

prefixItems.description: Half the length of the inner segment.
Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Convex polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points). Points are absolute; the loader centres the body on their centroid. Concave outlines must be split or drawn as a chain.

shape.title: Shape

sensor.description: When true it collides with nothing and raises sensor:enter and sensor:exit, as the sensor type does.
sensor.title: Sensor

group.description: The collision group it belongs to, one of the game's; omitted: sensor for a sensor (dynamic in a project with no game), dynamic on a dynamic body, else static.
group.title: Collision group

density.description: Density in kg/m²; with a dynamic body it sets the mass.
density.title: Density

friction.description: Surface friction; omitted uses the material's, else the physics default.
friction.title: Friction

restitution.description: Bounciness: 0 doesn't bounce, 1 keeps all its speed; omitted uses the material's, else 0.
restitution.title: Restitution

collider.description: A collision shape on the entity: static on its own, moved by a body beside it, or a trigger with sensor.
collider.title: Collider

kind.description: dynamic: gravity, forces and contacts move it. kinematic: only code moves it, and it carries what stands on it. static: it never moves.
kind.title: Kind

gravityScale.description: Multiplies the world's gravity on this body: 0 floats, -1 falls up; default 1.
gravityScale.title: Gravity scale

linearDamping.description: Slows the body's motion over time; default 0.
linearDamping.title: Linear damping

angularDamping.description: Slows the body's spin over time; default 0.
angularDamping.title: Angular damping

fixedRotation.description: When true, the body never turns.
fixedRotation.title: Fixed rotation

ccd.description: Continuous collision detection: when true, a fast body can't pass through thin colliders between steps.
ccd.title: CCD

body.description: Makes the entity's collider a physics body: dynamic, kinematic or static. A dynamic body needs physics.
body.title: Body

seat.description: The seat whose input drives this entity: 0 is the first player.
seat.title: Seat

player-input.description: Binds the entity to an input seat: behaviors on it read that player's actions through inputFor.
player-input.title: Player input

path-follow.description: Moves the entity along a waypoint path; with a kinematic body it carries what stands on it.
path-follow.title: Path follow

kind.description: directional: one acceleration everywhere inside. point: toward (or, negative, away from) the entity's pose. Default directional.
kind.title: Kind

force.description: directional: the acceleration it gives what is inside, m/s²; turns with the entity.
force.title: Force

strength.description: point: the acceleration toward its pose, m/s²; negative pushes away.
strength.title: Strength

falloff.description: point: how strength fades with distance from the pose: none, linear to zero at the collider's edge, or inverse-square past 1 m. Default none.
falloff.title: Falloff

drag.description: Slows what is inside against its velocity, per second: 0 none. Default 0.
drag.title: Drag

affects.description: Which bodies it pushes; omitted, every dynamic body inside.
affects.title: Affects

groups.description: Only bodies in one of these collision groups.

tags.description: Only entities with one of these tags.

force-area.description: Pushes the dynamic bodies inside the entity's sensor collider: one way, or toward or away from a point.
force-area.title: Force area

maxSpeed.description: Top speed under full input, m/s. Default 4.
maxSpeed.title: Max speed

accel.description: How fast it speeds up toward max speed, m/s². Default 40.
accel.title: Acceleration

decel.description: How fast it slows to rest with no input, m/s². Default 40.
decel.title: Deceleration

pushDynamic.description: Whether it pushes dynamic bodies it runs into. Default false.
pushDynamic.title: Push bodies

move.description: The vector action it walks by. Default "move".
move.title: Move action

character-top-down.description: Walks the entity in the plane from its seat's move action or an intent from code: a kinematic controller stopped and slid along by walls.
character-top-down.title: Character (top-down)

maxSpeed.description: Top speed under full input, m/s. Default 6.
maxSpeed.title: Max speed

accel.description: How fast it speeds up toward max speed, m/s². Default 60.
accel.title: Acceleration

decel.description: How fast it slows to rest with no input, m/s². Default 70.
decel.title: Deceleration

pushDynamic.description: Whether it pushes dynamic bodies it runs into. Default true.
pushDynamic.title: Push bodies

airControl.description: The share of accel and decel it has in the air, 0–1. Default 0.6.
airControl.title: Air control

jumpHeight.description: How high a full jump rises, m. Default 1.2.
jumpHeight.title: Jump height

gravityScale.description: Multiplies the world's gravity on it: 0 floats. Default 1.
gravityScale.title: Gravity scale

maxFallSpeed.description: The fastest it falls, m/s. Default 15.
maxFallSpeed.title: Max fall speed

coyoteMs.description: How long after running off a ledge a jump still works, ms. Default 100.
coyoteMs.title: Coyote time

jumpBufferMs.description: How long before landing a jump press is kept for the landing, ms. Default 100.
jumpBufferMs.title: Jump buffer

jumpCut.description: The share of its upward speed kept when the jump is released early, 0–1: 1 makes every jump full height. Default 0.5.
jumpCut.title: Jump cut

maxSlopeDeg.description: The steepest slope it walks up, degrees. Default 50.
maxSlopeDeg.title: Max slope

stepHeight.description: The tallest step it climbs without jumping, m; 0 climbs none. Default 0.04.
stepHeight.title: Step height

snapToGround.description: How far down it sticks to the ground over bumps and down slopes, m; 0 never snaps. Default 0.04.
snapToGround.title: Snap to ground

move.description: The action it runs by: a vector's x, or an axis. Default "move".
move.title: Move action

jump.description: The button it jumps with. Default "jump".
jump.title: Jump action

character-side-view.description: Runs and jumps the entity under gravity from its seat's move and jump actions or an intent from code, with coyote time, jump buffering and one-way platforms.
character-side-view.title: Character (side view)

arrive.description: How close to a waypoint or the destination counts as there, m. Default 0.12.
arrive.title: Arrive within

radius.description: Other agents closer than this are pushed apart from it, m. Default 0.3.
radius.title: Radius

separation.description: How hard that push is against the pull of the path: 0 never pushes. Default 1.5.
separation.title: Separation

repathTicks.description: Ticks between plans toward a moving entity, and how long without progress before it is blocked. Default 180: 3 s at 60 ticks a second.
repathTicks.title: Repath every

to.description: Where it walks from the start: a point, world m, or an entity it follows; omitted, it waits for setDestination.
to.title: Destination

anyOf.description: A point in world metres: placed with the entity, as a path is.
anyOf.title: Position

anyOf.description: An entity's id: it follows that entity.
anyOf.title: Reference

nav-agent.description: Walks the entity through the scene's walk areas to a point or another entity, kept apart from other agents; raises nav:arrived and nav:blocked.
nav-agent.title: Nav agent

kind.description: revolute: a hinge. prismatic: a slider along axis. rope: at most length apart. weld: held rigidly. spring: pulled toward length apart.
kind.title: Kind

revolute.label: Hinge
revolute.description: Turns about the anchors, within limits.

rope.label: Rope
rope.description: Keeps them at most length apart.

to.description: The other entity's id: one with a body or a collider that isn't a sensor (joint-ref-type otherwise), never this one (joint-self).
to.title: To

anchorA.title: Anchor
anchorA.description: Where the joint holds this entity's body, from its pose, m.

anchorB.title: Other anchor
anchorB.description: Where the joint holds the other entity's body, from its pose, m. Default: the point under `anchorA` when the joint is first made.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: prismatic: the slide direction, in this body's frame. Default [1, 0].

limits.description: revolute: this body's angle relative to `to`, radians (the editor shows degrees). prismatic: its travel along axis, m.
limits.title: Limits

motor.description: revolute and prismatic: drives this body's speed relative to `to` toward velocity.
motor.title: Motor

velocity.description: The target speed: rad/s for revolute (the editor shows deg/s), m/s for prismatic.
velocity.title: Velocity

maxForce.description: The most force it uses, N; torque for revolute, N·m.
maxForce.title: Max force

length.description: rope: the most they can be apart, m. spring: the rest length, m.
length.title: Length

stiffness.description: spring: how hard it pulls toward its rest length, N/m. Default 100.
stiffness.title: Stiffness

damping.description: spring: how fast its bounce dies down, N·s/m. Default 1.
damping.title: Damping

collide.description: Whether the two bodies still collide with each other. Default false.
collide.title: Collide

joint.description: Links the entity's body to another entity's: a hinge, a slider, a rope, a weld or a spring. Needs physics.
joint.title: Joint

type.description: The entity type it spawns, spawn-only types included; give this or `prefab`.
type.title: Type

fields.description: The fields each spawn of `type` gets, as a scene entity of that type writes them (a shape type's `shape`); its shapes, points and paths are relative to the spawn point. Without a shape, point or path, a spawn stands at the spawn point by its `at`.
fields.title: Fields

prefab.title: Prefab
prefab.description: The prefab it places; give this or `type`.

rate.description: Spawns a second while active and under the cap. Default 1.
rate.title: Rate

cap.description: The most of its spawns alive at once. Default 10.
cap.title: Cap

burst.description: How many it spawns at once when it starts, within the cap. Default 0.
burst.title: Burst

lifeMs.description: Each spawn goes this long after it appears, ms; omitted, spawns stay.
lifeMs.title: Lifetime

spread.description: Spawns appear at a random point within this radius of the entity's pose, m; 0 at the pose. Default 0.
spread.title: Spread

velocity.description: The velocity a spawn with a dynamic body starts with, m/s; turns with the entity.
velocity.title: Velocity

active.description: Whether it spawns; false holds it, and a block update starts it. Default true.
active.title: Active

spawner.description: Spawns entities of a type, or instances of a prefab, at a rate up to a cap of live ones; raises spawner:spawned for each.
spawner.title: Spawner

weight.description: Its pull on the camera beside the other targets: twice the weight, twice the pull. Default 1.
weight.title: Weight

seat.description: The seat whose view follows it, for split screens; omitted, every view does.
seat.title: Seat

camera-target.description: Marks what the camera follows when the game names no target: the weighted centre of every entity carrying it.
camera-target.title: Camera target

behaviors.description: Behavior blocks by name: each a typed set of fields this entity carries. `{}` carries a behavior with all its defaults; the type's required behaviors are always present.
behaviors.title: Behaviors

oneOf.description: nav: A walkable area, or a hole in one, for navigation without physics or a grid.

id.title: Id

type.description: Editor note: text pinned to a point. Never loaded into the game.
type.title: Type

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

layer.description: Scene layer, one of the game's layers; omitted means the type's default. The editor shows, hides and locks entities by layer, and the engine's own visuals draw on it; a type's shape visuals keep the draw layer their system chooses.
layer.title: Layer

group.description: The declared group (top-level `groups`) this belongs to. Its geometry is stored relative to the group's `at`, and members select and move together.
group.title: Group

off.description: When true the entity stays in the file but is not loaded, e.g. to A/B a change without deleting it.
off.title: Disabled

z.description: Draw order within the layer, an integer in [-10000, 10000]; higher draws on top, ties keep spawn order (on a y-sorted layer, z first, then y). Omitted means 0.
z.title: Z

at.description: Where the note shows, absolute world metres.
at.title: Position

text.description: The note, for whoever edits the scene next.
text.title: Text

oneOf.description: note: Editor note: text pinned to a point. Never loaded into the game.

Entity.description: An entity with a stable id. `type` picks the registered type and which fields apply.

pts.description: Waypoints in absolute world metres. The entity's shape is centred on each point in turn. At least 2, no repeats.
pts.title: Waypoints

mode.description: ping_pong: travel to the last point, then back. loop: after the last point, travel back to the first along the closing segment.
mode.title: Mode

speed.description: Travel speed along the path, m/s; must be > 0.
speed.title: Speed

pauseMs.description: How long it waits at each waypoint, in milliseconds. Omitted means 0.
pauseMs.title: Pause

Path.description: A waypoint path with linear segments.
Path.title: Path

Pt.description: A point [x, y] in world metres; y is down.

BodyShape.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...]. Metres, y is down; rotDeg in degrees.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.
